The true beta L2 times U-P0 bound is C*V*U^2*fixedLogs = C*X*U*fixedLogs. The derived U<=X^(1/2) and fixedLogs<=X^(1/4) give C*X^(7/4), not a presumed error budget.

The same real-rpow logarithm little-o theorem absorbs C*(log X)^A into X^(1/4) for every requested real A. Thus actual beta L2 times the literal U-P0 norm is <=X^2/(log X)^A beyond a threshold fixed before d.

Positivity of log X is explicitly secured at the threshold, so the final division and real exponent A are valid. Only sigma>0 is added, already a gate of the final medium obligation. V, raw zero, nonzero frequencies and the full obligation are not claimed by this leaf.
